reason: Confirmed on the files. On the public LB, SubmissionCount for TeamId 16810638 counts SCORED submissions only; it rises when a file completes, not when it is submitted. Snapshots: 20260927T0147Z = 40 (39-41 pending) -> 0531Z = 43; 1243Z = 44 (43/44 pending) -> 1343Z = 46. From 1443Z through 1743Z it stays 46 while 45 (56606948, sub 11:15:12Z) and 46 (56611472, sub 14:36:59Z) are PENDING (poll.log 18:04:40Z). LastSubmissionDate also updates on any scored file, even a NEG (0531Z shows 21:38:33 = probe 41, 0.949). The E10 loop snapshots hourly at xx:43Z (watch_loop.log RUN 6 17:45Z, next 18:43Z), and 45's 8.0 h mark is 19:15Z. So the 18:43Z or 19:43Z snapshot can already hold count 47. Using the 'newest/previous snapshot' as S0 (card 16:08Z (1) wording) would then compare 47 vs 47 and code a false N4. That error flips W1 rows (e.g. 45 U4 -> exp76e vs N4 -> exp76a/exp76d). The count-based FRESHNESS rule exists only for the old ladder watcher (CONTEXT l.2678-2683, base 40 hardcoded) and is not yet adopted for 45/46. The UP test itself stays sound with an older S0, because public bests never fall. Cost is zero: files only, no mechanism, no Kaggle action, no R8/R1-R10 conflict. It does not touch the finals, which need a display >= 0.955 and no UP test. Small gap in the finding: it has no rule for a 46->48 jump or for an ERROR that leaves the count unchanged.
fix: Append one pre-score line to CONTEXT before 45 turns terminal. For 45: S0 = experiments/e10_watch/20260927T1743Z.txt (l.428: rank 288, 0.954, SubmissionCount 46, LastSubmissionDate 05:28:22), or any later snapshot still showing 46. S1 = the first snapshot, or a manual `kaggle competitions leaderboard -d` download into a new folder, whose count is 47 AND whose LastSubmissionDate = 2026-09-27 11:15:12. For 46: S0 = the newest snapshot with 47, S1 = the first with 48 and LastSubmissionDate 14:36:59. If the first post-S0 snapshot shows +2 (46 -> 48), apply the co-completion rule of CONTEXT l.2684-2687 (higher display takes the UP; equal displays -> both NEU/MASKED, never N4). If a ref is ERROR in poll.log, record whether the count moved, then re-base the expected count for the other ref. UP = some TeamId above us in S0 is below us in S1. Log the S0/S1 file names, counts, LastSubmissionDate and passed TeamIds. A download that is stale (count not yet raised) gets re-downloaded, up to 3 tries at 2 min, else AMBIGUOUS (not N4).
realistic_gain: No score gain; this fixes the process. It prevents a false N4 on 45 (likely if 45 completes before the 18:43Z or 19:43Z E10 snapshot) that would pick the wrong W1 row for 28 Sep (exp76e dropped, fine-tune/cap line misread). It has no effect on the finals (#37 + #38) or the private LB.
